items.topic: jsl.tmLanguage lambda arrow and table mapping regex typos
items.claim: Lambda arrow pattern in jsl.tmLanguage matches '<=' ; table member mapping uses '<==>'
items.fact: Lambda arrow regex should match '=>' (it matches '<='); table member mapping has an extra '=' ('<==>'); modifiersRulesForRow uses singular <key>pattern</key>. Also spec.md/AGENTS.md grammar scope tables are wrong: entity -> storage.types.class.jsl (not keyword.control.class.jsl), line comment -> comment.line.double-slash.jsl, string -> string.quoted.double.states, AGENTS meta.class.*.jsl block scopes do not match.

items.claim: docs describe transform from disk, --strict validate, simple save
items.fact: TransformCommand reads live getLoadedEsmModel() (not disk), runs esm2ui + UI EVL (needs judo-tatami-client-workflow in pom). ValidateCommand returns non-zero on any validation error (--strict deprecated). SaveCommand serializes to byte[]/temp file/atomic move with phased exit codes 2/3. DiscardCommand still ships --from; setupModelLoaders unconditionally adds generated-resources/model and cli-generated.

items.topic: Zeta transformations parallel flag and version

items.fact: All five use .parallel(false); pom.xml:123 sets judo-zeta-version=1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.

query_harness.py resolves query-tasks.json/rich-seed.json/mockcli via ROOT (ab-tool-call) but they live in luna/ -> FileNotFoundError. Harness emits --index "" on missing move index but mockcli rejects it cleanly (classification nit, rejected as bug).

Deployment map keyed by realm only, so every actor in a realm reuses the first actor's client config. Workflow metrics: getFailedCounts() streams the completed map and stoppedTransformation never increments, so counts always 0.
Uses pathInfo.startsWith('/'+FQN-path) without segment boundary and findAny(); MyActorX matches MyActor, and when one FQN prefixes another, first in list order wins rather than longest.

items.topic: Tatami client workflow: useCache ignored, XMI cast
items.claim: useCache param and XMI save work
items.fact: useCache (default true) never read: WorkflowHelper.createEsm2UiWork() builds Esm2UiWork(transformationContext) without it (WorkflowHelper.java:114). DefaultClientWorkflowSave.setXMIID (line 99) lacks return/else and falls to cast (JsonUuidResource) at line 102 -> ClassCastException for XMI resources.

DefaultLiquibaseExecutor swallows all non-Liquibase exceptions with an empty catch and its 4-arg executeLiquibaseScript is unsynchronized (PatternValidator at validator:53 has a missing-pattern-constraint issue).
